This third bail application is filed on behalf of the applicant - Snadeep alias Chotu Bhatiya S/o Jitendra Bhatiya, under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 in connection with Crime No.636/2021, registered at Police Station Ashoka Garden, Distt. Bhopal (M.P.), for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 376(3), 506 of IPC and also under Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 23/07/2021.
It is pointed out that there are contradictions in the statement of the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: Examination-in-chief was recorded on 12/10/2021.
She did not appear and put finally cross-examined on 21/02/2023.
There is gap of about 16-17 months in the examination-in-chief and the cross-examination.
It is submitted that DNA report is inconclusive.
It says that uninterpretable profile is received.
Prosecutrix is examined.
Trial is going to take time inasmuch as though applicant is in custody for about 20 months but only one witness has been examined.
Reading para-18, it is pointed that prosecutrix has admitted that she has not gone out with the applicant on day of Eid whereas in the FIR itself mentioned that incident took place on the day of Eid.

In para-19 also she had admitted that since her relationship with the accused was disclosed by certain girls of the colony, there was a dispute between between her mother and the mother of accused which is corroborated from para-9 of her testimony.
Therefore, prayer is made to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Shri Ajay Tamrakar, learned Panel Lawyer, for the respondent-State opposes the prayer for grant of bail.

Looking to the fact that prosecutrix did not appear before trial Court for a long duration of over one year and trial is going to take substantially long time as examination of prosecutrix has taken over one and half year's time, on the ground of delay in trial, and taking these facts into consideration that prosecutrix is already examined, there are no chances of tampering with the evidence, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to extend benefit of bail to the applicant.
Hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, this bail application is allowed.

I t is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the said Court on the dates given by the concerned Court during pendency of the trial.

It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial, however, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE ts Sandeep @ Chotu Bhatiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26044258/
